name: maison-tanstack
description: From UX to AX: one set of Strapi MCP tools serving a LINE app, its concierge and staff. The customer app is TanStack Start, and every model call goes through TanStack AI.

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix strapi && npm install --prefix app && node scripts/init-env.mjs
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n strapi,app -c magenta,green "npm run develop --prefix strapi" "npm run dev --prefix app"
